text: ‘Developing countries remain poor due to the continuing impact of colonialism.’ Evaluate this view.
OR
‘Migrants from poor countries rarely gain any benefit from working in rich countries.’ Evaluate this
view. [35]
Section B: Media
EITHER
‘The media is an instrument of ideological control.’ Evaluate this view. [35]
OR
‘The new media has given citizens more power to influence politics.’ Evaluate this view. [35]
Section C: Religion
EITHER
‘Women have complete equality with men in religious organisations today.’ Evaluate this view.
OR
‘Religion has little influence in Western societies today.’ Evaluate this view. [35]
